title: A Db2 BOOLEAN column stops ASN capture for every table
symptom: No change events for any TPC-DI table after T. ASNCDC.IBMSNAP_CAPTRACE: ASN0552E (SQLCODE -804) inserting into the change table of DIMDATE, then ASN0008I: the Capture program was stopped. Every registration still shows state A, and Debezium logs Starting streaming with no error
cause: Db2's SQL Replication (ASN capture), which Debezium's Db2 connector reads, doesn't support BOOLEAN; Debezium can only snapshot such tables (its documentation's data type table)
effect: Silent and database-wide: one table with a BOOLEAN column stops change capture for all tables
fix: Use SMALLINT 0/1 or CHAR(1) instead of BOOLEAN; check a schema for BOOLEAN columns before ADDTABLE; watch ASNCDC.IBMSNAP_CAPTRACE for ASN0008I and ASN0552E (capture stopped), since Debezium reports nothing. The test maps booleans to SMALLINT 0/1 on Db2
